paragraphs: An open Salmonella outbreak linked to raw oysters continues across 13 states, with 28 cases and 5 hospitalizations reported as of October 30 [1]. The outbreak is caused by Salmonella Telelkebir, and consumers should avoid raw oysters until further guidance is provided [1].
The broccoli sprouts Salmonella outbreak is now over, the CDC reported [2][17]. That outbreak, caused by Salmonella Bovismorbificans, sickened 34 people across 6 states with 3 hospitalizations [2].

Brad's Raw Chips is recalling Brad's Plant Based Crunchy Kale and Brad's Veggie Chips Kale products because they may contain thallium, a naturally occurring metal [4][26]. Consumers who purchased these items should stop eating them and consider returning them [4].

Once Upon a Farm is recalling all lots and varieties of Tractor Wheel Organic Toddler Soft-Baked bars due to choking hazard risk; the bars can rapidly hydrate into a dense, sticky mass when chewed [6]. Vitality Works Inc. is also recalling 365 Whole Foods Market Standardized + Full Spectrum Blend Ashwagandha Capsules (lot number 2025-26227) due to potential Salmonella contamination [8]. The FDA has added a 21st cinnamon product—Wise Wife brand ground cinnamon from SLR Food Distribution Inc.—to its list of products with dangerously high lead levels [20].
